about_short_description.short_description: NuMind is a SAAS company that offers data scientists, analysts and software engineers AI tools to create custom NLP models.

product.name: NuExtract
product.description: A foundation large language model designed for structured information extraction from documents, converting text into structured data formats.

product.name: NuMind Desktop Tool
product.description: A desktop application for creating custom NLP models focused on information extraction tasks like classification and named entity recognition without sharing data externally.

product.name: NuMind API Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform enabling users with technical expertise to extract structured information from documents at scale using NuExtract.

product.name: On-Premises Enterprise Deployment
product.description: A deployment option allowing organizations to run customized AI models locally to maintain data privacy and control over sensitive information.

product.name: Autonomous Agent Builder
product.description: A service to customize foundation models to learn operational workflows and autonomously perform actions and generate formatted content.
